senses.gloss: (cmp. שחרר, v.חרם), Pa. שַׁחֵר [to declare a thing or man free, ownerless property,] to confiscate, press into public service.
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Numbers 16:15">Targ. O. Num. XVI, 15</cite> <cite ref="U00719"><he>שָׁחַרִית</he></cite> ed. Berl. (Mss. <he>שְׁחָרִ׳</he>, <cite ref="U00719"><he>שַׁחֲרֵית</he></cite>, <he>שָׁחָרִ׳</he>, v. Berl. O. II, p. 42; Y. I <cite ref="U00719"><he>שְׁחָרִית</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Samuel 12:3">Targ. I Sam. XII, 3</cite>.—
<cite ref="Berakhot 56a:1">Ber. 56ᵃ</cite> <he>חזית דמְשַׁחְרֵי לך פרסאי וכ׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>דמשחדי</he>, corr. acc.) thou shalt see in thy dream that the Parthians press thee into service &c.
Ib. דמשחדי לך רומאי Ms. M. (corr. acc.; ed. אתו רומאי ושבו לך).—Part. pass. Pe. שָׁחִיר; f. שְׁחִירְתָּא sent abroad.

<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Hosea 7:11">Targ. Hos. VII, 11</cite> <he>כיונה ש׳ דאיתנסבן בנהא</he> ed. Lag. (ed. <cite ref="U01970"><he>שְׁרִיתֲתָא</he></cite>, q. v.) as a dove sent abroad when her young were taken away (h. text <he>פותה</he>, v.
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 84">Midr. Till. to Ps. LXXXIV</cite>).
